About Us

Jharkhand Bijli Vitran Nigam Limited

JBVNL is the largest Distribution Company of Jharkhand State, incorporated primarily to carry out distribution of electricity to retail and bulk consumers in the state of Jharkhand. The company started operations on 6th Jan, 2014, after the unbundling of the erstwhile Jharkhand State Electricity Board (JSEB) in the year 2013.

2014Operations since 6th Jan
3.2M+Registered consumers
2,150 MWPeak load (FY 17-18)
Consumer categories HT LTIS DS NDS IAS

Powering Progress

Achievement & Milestones

A snapshot of JBVNL's journey in strengthening electricity access, distribution infrastructure, service quality, digital transformation and renewable energy initiatives.

⚡
32,497 Villages in Jharkhand
🏘
29,376 Inhabited villages
🔌
7,25,687 Smart meters installed till Mar 2026
☀
1,119 MW Renewable sources readily available
2017

100% Village Electrification

JBVNL completed electrification of the remaining villages identified for the programme by December 2017 under DDUGJY and State-sponsored schemes.

2,932 villages electrified
Digital Transformation

Consumer Services Go Digital

ERP, SCADA, online connection services, capex monitoring and consumer-focused digital tools were introduced to improve service delivery.

Suvidha • Sashakt • eZy-bZly
Infrastructure

Distribution Network Strengthened

Major distribution strengthening works included new substations, line augmentation, distribution transformers and LT AB cable deployment.

19,719 CKM LT AB cable replacement till Mar 2026
Renewable Energy

Cleaner Power Portfolio

JBVNL's current renewable availability includes wind, solar, canal-top and hydel sources, supporting a lower-carbon power supply.

300 MW Wind • 476 MW Solar • 341 MW Hydel • 2 MW Canal Top
People & Capability

Building a Skilled Workforce

JBVNL has focused on organizational strengthening and employee capability development through structured training and institutional collaboration.

15 circle-level training centres planned
